title: Oversight Data Quality vs. Quantity Tradeoff: How Much Does Overseer Quality Matter Relative to Oversight Volume?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: the quality-representativeness tradeoff is listed as an open problem. Knowing whether fewer high-quality labels beat many low-quality labels directly guides oversight resource allocation.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires training student models under two different oversight regimes (few strong labels vs. many weak labels) and comparing outcomes. Multiple fine-tuning runs with different data configurations are required. Heavy for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two separate training conditions, generating labels from both strong and weak overseers, and evaluating student quality in both. Controlling for total compute-equivalent effort adds complexity. Tight for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
